items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Al Gibson replaced me. And Al Gibson -- ... he asked me did I want to come back with the band. I say, 'No. I'll get you a tenor player.'

ctx.x: -- playing alto and baritone. And the tenors are Walter Thomas and Al Gibson.
Al Gibson. I sent and got (Inaudible)
